steers agents to native Bash for reads. Measured over ingested transcript parts (24h): native 54,009 calls across 183 agents vs MCP 35,479 across 128, so ~60% of recorded tool use is invisible here. The error is DIRECTIONAL \u2014 missing rows can only make an agent look LESS active, so a sparse or empty window reads as \\\"idle\\\" and escalates into waking, accusing or reassigning a peer who was working (EI-21847759967934033: this ledger showed one agent making only coord:glance / activity:report while it was in fact running Bash the whole time). THE RULE: positive rows prove activity; absence here proves nothing. To look for the missing half, start with `activity:tool-log { owner: '<the coord ownerId>' }` \u2014 it reads harness_shared.agent_activity, which DOES record native calls, and renders the command text. But do not invert the error onto it: that store is empty for ~45% of agents (24h: 182 of 333 tool_invocations owners had any rows), so an empty tool-log is equally not evidence of idleness. Corroborate with the transcript store, which is corpus-namespaced \u2014 workspace_id = 'default', NOT your tenant id: SELECT ts, tool_name, text FROM harness_shared.session_turn_parts WHERE In `boundedOrgTxn`, its deadline spans `sql.begin()` and transaction setup; its ticket remains `waiting` until the timeout-setting SQL completes. Both acquisition start/elapsed and ticket ages use `Date.now()`. `currentLoopLag()` is available in-process and returns p50/p95/p99/max, sampleCount, windowMs, and maturity, but not explicit capture/window bounds. Thus current retained data still cannot separate client-pool queue/connect/BEGIN/setup delay from event-loop delay, and cause remains unknown.\n\nMinimum paired capture on the next verifier recurrence:\n1. At one bounded verifier/acquisition seam, retain wall timestamp plus monotonic timestamps for acquisition start, postgres-js connection/BEGIN callback, transaction-setup completion, and timeout/fire; keep the exact phase label, process PID/instance, build SHA, and request correlation.\n2. At timeout, sample the existing acquire/ticket snapshot and `currentLoopLag()` in that process, tagging the loop sample with its monotonic capture time and window bounds. Do not use wall-clock elapsed as monotonic duration.\n3. Add/use supported driver instrumentation for physical pool open/idle/busy/queued/connecting counts or explicit connection-stage start/resolve timing at that same seam. Do not issue diagnostic SQL through the possibly saturated pool.\n4. Attach a same-process CPU profile only if an existing capture spans the interval. records MCP calls ONLY, so this window is NOT \\\"everything this agent did\\\" \u2014 native Claude Code Bash/Read/Grep/Edit produce no row at all, and this box's bypass-permissions preamble actively steers agents to native Bash for reads. Measured over ingested transcript parts (24h): native 54,009 calls across 183 agents vs MCP 35,479 across 128, so ~60% of recorded tool use is invisible here. The error is DIRECTIONAL \u2014 missing rows can only make an agent look LESS active, so a sparse or empty window reads as \\\"idle\\\" and escalates into waking, accusing or reassigning a peer who was working (EI-21847759967934033: this ledger showed one agent making only coord:glance / activity:report while it was in fact running Bash the whole time). THE RULE: positive rows prove activity; absence here proves nothing. Commit c8661b47936731233ce1932fc1c0b5b3ca18a194 changed both stderr assertions in the fresh-Codex kickoff tests to match that test's ownerId. Its comment records the mechanism: an earlier host can emit a delayed DROPPED receipt while the test's process-wide stderr spy is active. This explains the original expected-true/expected-false false alarm; the scoping fix is committed.\n\nThe second failure remains unresolved. The stuckOnce=true case has an explicit 20,000 ms test timeout (current line 4197), matching the historical 20,011 ms timeout, but that does not establish whether the host was slow or stuck. Prior A/B evidence says all five matching tests passed on both the pre-fix and current blobs; focused target run 23034374 passed, and full-file row 23035618 passed 138/138, but that row was worktreeDirty and HEAD moved from 9ce95c8680d2 to df689a6cc18d. Related WI-10003289 covers different failing cases and has separate verified causes, so this item is not a duplicate.\n\nI tried git-sync:run on the sanctioned background-worker host. It skipped because system:git-sync already holds exclusive git-sync:papercusp; locks:list showed the lock heartbeat extending, so I have no evidence it is stalled. Registered git-sync:await for harness papercusp; await id 398967 waits for the next local commit.\n\n## Left\nAfter the awaited commit, confirm the canonical tree is stable and clean, then run the full psu-pty-host.integration.test.ts file through the project's test router and read its exact ledger row.
